Publish.LongDescription:
## ❤️ Bikes + Paths (B+P) is retiring!
### Thank you for using this mod! Its features are now in River-Mochi's [Adjust All Speed Limits (ASL)](https://mods.paradoxplaza.com/mods/149990/Windows), with an advanced better in-city UI panel for bike and pedestrian paths. And the ASL Options menu has the separate bicycle and scooter speed tuning, and vehicle stats you had in Bikes and Paths before.
### Moving to ASL - You can safely remove B+P anytime and switch to ASL 1.3.0 or newer. No reset is required. - Optional: if you want to restore vanilla values right away, use **Reset to Game Defaults** button with B+P alone, let the changes finish and save your city. Existing paths (including legacy hidden vehicle pathways) may retain modified limits otherwise. No need to revisit old saves. - When ASL is installed and controls both speed features, simply remove B+P. - B+P 1.1.7 automatically leaves overlapping speed tuning to ASL. - The old status and debug controls have also moved to ASL. - This mod remains available for the transition and will work as a standalone, but once you install All Speed Limits, this mod should be removed to avoid conflicts.
Thank you, River-mochi
### Credits - River-mochi - author - Thumbnail: photo of dog by Joe Caione: https://unsplash.com/photos/shallow-focus-photography-of-white-shih-tzu-puppy-running-on-the-grass-qO-PIF84Vxg
Publish.ChangeLog: - Retired: all features are now in Adjust All Speed Limits (ASL), Please install that mod instead. - Added migration instructions and direct ASL web link. - Standalone tuning/reset controls remain available for safe migration. Overlapping tuning is delegated to ASL.
